description: HarnessKit loop-engine workflow skeleton (Batch 3.8). STATIC EXAMPLE ONLY — no code consumes this file; no workflow runner exists. Invocations reference Batch 3.7-verified capabilities. Marked-future items are not callable as written. Honors the kill switch philosophy and report-only-first rollout. Do not treat any 'future' entry as live.

principles.statement: Proceed automatically through safe, scoped, reversible work.
Humans enter only at risk boundaries, not at every node.
The verifier is never the implementer; subagents inspect, the main agent writes.
New loops start at report-only (L0/L1); promotion requires evidence.
Smallest safe patch; Ponytail governs sprawl under Safety > Correctness > Maintainability > Compactness.
No commit/push/PR/merge/open-source without an explicit named approval gate.
Private memory and raw runs are never shared by default; only sanitized artifacts cross boundaries.
Every loop iteration appends to the run log; no silent steps.
Repair loops are capped; on exhaustion the run stops at NEEDS_USER.

L0_DRAFT.notes: Matches reference/autonomy-levels.md active tier L0 (Advisory). Inspect + write run artifacts/plans/reports only.

L1_REPORT_ONLY.notes: Emit findings/diagnostics and PROPOSE patches (not applied). Default for new workflows.

L2_ASSISTED_FIX.notes: Apply scoped non-sensitive patches with maker/checker + risk gates. Requires L1 gates satisfied first.

L3_UNATTENDED_BOUNDED.notes: Autonomous within budget + kill criteria; stops at any gate/limit. Not enabled until L2 quality proven.

L4_TEAM_ORG_GOVERNED.notes: HarnessKit-specific (B3.5). L3 within a team/org with role-aware gates + handoff packets. Not in the external model.

NO_GATE._description: Safe autonomous action; act and continue.

REPORT_ONLY._description: Act, but surface what was done; no approval needed.

ASK_BEFORE_WRITE._description: Pause before a sensitive-path or runtime write (per profile sensitive_paths).

ASK_BEFORE_EXPANSION._description: Proposed (B3): pause before scope grows — new dependency, new module, or line/file budget exceeded.

ce_debug.notes: Runtime/server debugging; no generic core script exists.

ce_proof.notes: Test/validation; pairs with harnesskit eval suite (scripts/run-evals.js).

superpowers.invocation: superpowers:* skills (writing-plans, systematic-debugging, verification-before-completion, test-driven-development, subagent-driven-development)
superpowers.notes: Plugin enabled + callable, but harness global-policy.superpowers_enabled=false → not auto-routed. Forensics pass before routing.

codex_cli.notes: OpenAI Codex CLI (codex-cli 0.142.2 on PATH); ChatGPT-OAuth. NO /codex:* slash command exists. Every run is a model call. Adversary + diff-review (C1 read-only). Arg shape is an open question.

ponytail_review.notes: Patch over-engineering review = compactness governor. Numeric budget + PASS/SHRINK/BLOCK_EXPANSION verdict is FUTURE (not native).

playwright.invocation: playwright (Python on PATH); harness UI QA via /ce-test-browser
playwright.notes: Globally available, NOT harness-bound (no package.json binding). Use as adapter for UI workflows.

structured_memory_capture.notes: Explicit manual fact capture (validate + poisoning scan + source hash). NOT auto-wired into capture pipeline (B5b).

structured_memory_read.notes: Explicit manual fact read (active-only default, filters, source-drift warnings). NOT auto-wired into retrieval (B5c).

human_gate.invocation: approval ledger (scripts/check-approval-needed.js, grant-approval.js); enforced when hooks wired
human_gate.notes: Risk-based approval; advisory until hooks wired (settings.json hooks={} today).

ponytail_budget._notes: Thresholds are placeholders; exact line/file budgets are an open question. Crossing a budget triggers ASK_BEFORE_EXPANSION.

docs_only.notes: Markdown/comments only. Low risk; scoped writes allowed but no runtime/sensitive paths.

small_code_change.notes: Low-risk, small, non-sensitive change. Report-only patch proposal until L2.

runtime_code_change.notes: Non-trivial logic. Codex adversary is optional (external CLI); superpowers optional until routed.

ui_browser_change.notes: Playwright is adapter/global, not harness-bound; default UI QA is /ce-test-browser.

backend_server_debugging.notes: Reproduce before fixing; /ce-debug drives diagnosis. No generic core server-debug script exists.

security_sensitive_change.notes: Auth/secrets/sensitive paths/integrations. security_review = /ce-code-review security personas + repo-forensics (optional_external). Non-clean forensics = hard stop (NEEDS_USER), no auto-loop.

large_refactor.notes: Architecture-heavy. Ponytail plan review is HARD here (expansion gate likely). Stage the implementation.

memory_behavior._notes: Touches scripts/structured-memory.js + facts schema; require self-test (--self-test) + evals.

memory_schema_change.notes: memory/ + schema + facts store. Append-only NDJSON discipline; never break existing records.

adapter_project_specific_change.notes: adapters/<x> + project profile/maps. Project-owner approval required (B3.5). Never write project repos with real business data without explicit gate.

open_source_transfer_package.notes: Publishable core / transfer bundle. ASK_BEFORE_PUBLISH is mandatory. Run the Batch 2 extraction gates (grep for owner/project/secrets) before any publish.

anti_pattern_guardrails.same_agent_verifies_itself: Maker/checker separation: subagents read-only, main agent writes; verifier_not_implementer required; CE/Codex reviewers are distinct from /ce-work.
anti_pattern_guardrails.no_attempt_cap: max_repair_loops per workflow; on exhaustion stop at NEEDS_USER.
anti_pattern_guardrails.vague_triage_output: Schema-validated structured outputs (route.json, facts schema, reviewer verdict objects); no free-text-only verdicts.
anti_pattern_guardrails.auto_fix_too_early: Readiness ladder: L0/L1 report-only default; fixes only at L2+ with gates.
anti_pattern_guardrails.shared_state_without_schema: NDJSON facts with validateFactRecord + provenance (B5a); loop state must be schema'd before use.
anti_pattern_guardrails.broad_connector_permissions: connector_permissions=read_only_by_default; capability-registry access tiers; MCP gated/profile-based; no write-capable connectors by default.
anti_pattern_guardrails.no_kill_switch: DISABLED file / HARNESSKIT_DISABLED honored by every script; plus per-workflow kill_criteria.
anti_pattern_guardrails.fixing_flakes_with_app_code: Mandatory tests/evals gate; a flake is repaired in the test/fixture, never by changing application logic (kill_criteria flag).
anti_pattern_guardrails.auto_merge_or_publish_without_allowlist: ASK_BEFORE_PUBLISH mandatory; no commit/push/PR/merge/open-source without explicit named approval (push-control).
anti_pattern_guardrails.no_run_log: run_log_required=true; per-run append-only decision-log.ndjson + tool-log.ndjson + .index.ndjson; a run-log entry is required per loop iteration.
anti_pattern_guardrails.overengineering_code_sprawl: PONYTAIL compactness governor: /ponytail-review + line/file budgets + ASK_BEFORE_EXPANSION; Safety > Correctness > Maintainability > Compactness; cannot shrink away safety/correctness/audit lines.

Exact line/file thresholds for the expansion gate (current values are placeholders).
Whether Superpowers should be routed automatically (flip global-policy.superpowers_enabled) and which gates it owns.
Whether Grill-me remains quarantined or is promoted to an auto, risk-triggered reviewer.
When to enable L2 assisted fixes (which L1 gates must be green first).
When to allow L3 unattended bounded (required L2 track record + enforced budgets/kill criteria).
How to represent reviewer rejections in run state (new REJECTED/REPAIR sub-states + a reviewer-verdict artifact).
How to integrate structured memory into context (Batch 5d: read-facts into search-memory/context-pack with provenance).
How team/org L4 policy should override workflow config (precedence: org > team > user > workflow defaults).
